healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify Ably credentials by requesting application statistics.

messages.history.title: Retrieve message history for a channel.
messages.history.description: Retrieve persisted or recent message history for an Ably channel via GET /channels/{channelId}/messages.

messages.publish.title: Publish a message to a channel.
messages.publish.description: Publish one message to a channel. Ably answers 201 with an empty body on success, so the result echoes channelId and optional name.

presence.list.title: List instantaneous presence on a channel.
presence.list.description: Obtain members currently present on an Ably channel via GET /channels/{channelId}/presence.

channels.get.title: Get channel details
channels.get.description: Retrieve metadata and occupancy for one Ably channel via GET /channels/{channel_id}. Maps to ABLY_GET_CHANNEL_DETAILS.

channel_id.description: Channel ID whose metadata should be returned.

channels.list.title: List channels
channels.list.description: Enumerate active channels via GET /channels. Optional by=id returns names; by=value returns ChannelDetails. Maps to ABLY_LIST_CHANNELS.

by.description: Return channel ids only (id) or ChannelDetails (value).

prefix.description: Restrict results to channel names with this prefix.

messages.batch_publish.title: Batch publish messages
messages.batch_publish.description: Publish the same messages to many channels in one POST /messages BatchSpec. Maps to ABLY_PUBLISH_BATCH_MESSAGES.

messages.versions.title: Get message versions
messages.versions.description: Retrieve every stored version of one message via GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{serial}/versions. Maps to ABLY_GET_MESSAGE_VERSIONS.

presence.batch.title: Query batch presence
presence.batch.description: Query current presence on many channels via GET /presence?channels=. Maps to ABLY_BATCH_PRESENCE.

separator.description: Alternate separator for the channels list. Default comma.

presence.batch_history.title: Query batch presence history
presence.batch_history.description: Query presence for many channels via GET /presence with a channel list plus history window params. Maps to ABLY_BATCH_PRESENCE_HISTORY. Official batch presence is current occupancy; start/end/limit/direction are forwarded as query parameters.

start.description: Start of the query interval in milliseconds since epoch.

end.description: End of the query interval in milliseconds since epoch.

presence.history.title: Get channel presence history
presence.history.description: Retrieve presence history for one channel via GET /channels/{channel_id}/presence/history. Maps to ABLY_GET_PRESENCE_HISTORY.

channel_id.description: Channel whose presence history should be returned.

start.description: Start of the query interval in milliseconds since epoch.

end.description: End of the query interval in milliseconds since epoch.

push.batch_publish.title: Batch publish push notifications
push.batch_publish.description: Publish many push notifications via POST /push/batch/publish. Maps to ABLY_PUBLISH_PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_BATCH.

recipient.description: Recipient object or array of recipients.

payload.description: Push payload (notification, data, apns, fcm, web).

push.channel_subscriptions.delete.title: Delete channel subscription
push.channel_subscriptions.delete.description: Unsubscribe devices or clients from push channels via DELETE /push/channelSubscriptions. Maps to ABLY_DELETE_CHANNEL_SUBSCRIPTION.

channel.description: Optional channel to unsubscribe from. Omit to match all channels.

client_id.description: Client ID filter. Mutually exclusive with device_id.

device_id.description: Device ID filter. Mutually exclusive with client_id.

push.channel_subscriptions.list.title: List push channel subscriptions
push.channel_subscriptions.list.description: List push channel subscriptions via GET /push/channelSubscriptions. Maps to ABLY_LIST_PUSH_CHANNEL_SUBSCRIPTIONS.

concat_filters.description: When true, match client_id or device_id.

push.channels.list.title: List push channels
push.channels.list.description: List channels with at least one push subscriber via GET /push/channels. Maps to ABLY_LIST_PUSH_CHANNELS.

push.devices.get.title: Get push device registration
push.devices.get.description: Get one registered push device via GET /push/deviceRegistrations/{device_id}. Maps to ABLY_GET_PUSH_DEVICE.

push.devices.list.title: List registered push devices
push.devices.list.description: List push device registrations via GET /push/deviceRegistrations. Maps to ABLY_LIST_REGISTERED_PUSH_DEVICES.

push.devices.patch.title: Patch push device registration
push.devices.patch.description: Partially update a push device via PATCH /push/deviceRegistrations/{deviceId}. Maps to ABLY_PATCH_PUSH_DEVICE_REGISTRATION.

metadata.description: Device metadata. Replaces the existing object.

push.devices.register.title: Register push device
push.devices.register.description: Register a device for push via POST /push/deviceRegistrations. Maps to ABLY_REGISTER_PUSH_DEVICE.

device_secret.description: Device secret used for device authentication.

push_recipient.description: Push recipient (transportType plus token or web keys).

push.devices.unregister.title: Unregister push device
push.devices.unregister.description: Unregister one device via DELETE /push/deviceRegistrations/{device_id}. Maps to ABLY_UNREGISTER_PUSH_DEVICE.

push.devices.unregister_all.title: Unregister all matching push devices
push.devices.unregister_all.description: Unregister matching devices via DELETE /push/deviceRegistrations?deviceId= or clientId=. Maps to ABLY_UNREGISTER_ALL_PUSH_DEVICES.

client_id.description: Filter by client ID. Mutually exclusive with device_id.

device_id.description: Filter by device ID. Mutually exclusive with client_id.

push.devices.update.title: Update push device registration
push.devices.update.description: Upsert a push device via PUT /push/deviceRegistrations/{device_id}. Maps to ABLY_UPDATE_PUSH_DEVICE.

device_id.description: Device registration id in the path.

push.publish.title: Publish push notification
push.publish.description: Publish a push notification directly to recipients via POST /push/publish. Maps to ABLY_PUBLISH_PUSH_NOTIFICATION.

recipient.description: Recipient identified by clientId, deviceId, or a platform token.

push.description: Push payload with optional notification, data, apns, fcm, and web.

time.get.title: Get Ably service time
time.get.description: Return Ably service time as a one-element array of milliseconds since epoch via GET /time. Maps to ABLY_GET_SERVICE_TIME.

tokens.request.title: Request access token
tokens.request.description: Request an Ably Token via POST /keys/{key_name}/requestToken. Maps to ABLY_REQUEST_ACCESS_TOKEN. Unsigned requests use the stored API key.

nonce.description: Random nonce. Ably generates one when omitted.

client_id.description: Optional client identifier bound to the token.

timestamp.description: Token request timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
